title: Dental sealants for children
what: The dentist fills the grooves on the chewing teeth with a thin protective material. This keeps food from getting stuck there, so tooth decay is less likely.
why: Usually on new permanent back teeth, soon after they come in: at about 6 to 8 years and 11 to 13 years.
tell_doctor: If your child is afraid of the dentist. The dentist will go more gently

prepare.title: Clean teeth
prepare.text: Before the visit, have your child brush their teeth.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit. Eating right after the procedure is sometimes not advised.

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Tell your child honestly: it will not hurt, there is no injection, they just need to sit with their mouth open.

bring: Your child's medical record, if you have one
steps: The dentist checks the teeth and cleans the grooves
The tooth is kept dry with cotton rolls
A special solution is put on the tooth, then rinsed off
The protective material is put into the grooves
The material hardens under a blue light in a few seconds
feel: The taste of the solution and a dry mouth may be unpleasant
after: Your child can usually eat after an hour. Check with the dentist
Have the sealant checked at check-ups every six months. Sometimes it needs a touch-up

faq.q: At what age should sealants be done?
faq.a: Usually right after the permanent back teeth come in: at 6 to 8 and at 11 to 13 years. The dentist will advise the timing.
No. There is no drilling and no injection. The tooth is only cleaned and covered with the material.
Usually several years. At each check-up, the dentist checks them and adds material if needed.
